opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity then note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search round-trip flights on Google Flights from Paris, search hotels on Booking, find a top tour on Viator, and save a summary trip note.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, enter destination and dates, search and note cheapest flight price
Open Booking, enter destination and same dates, search, open top hotel and note name and price
Open Viator, search for the main attraction tour in destination, open top result and note title and price
Open notes app, create new note 'Trip <dest> <dates>: flight ..., hotel ..., tour ...' and submit

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages' stats into a note
opportunities.description: Look up two Python packages on PyPI, open each repository for GitHub stars, and record a comparison note with version, date, stars, license.
steps: Search first package on PyPI, open its page, note version, date, license
Open its Repository/Source link and note stars
Create a note comparing both packages

opportunities.name: Browser feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse and MDN, then draft an email reply to a person stating the supported browser version with the MDN link.
steps: Search feature on caniuse for the browser support version
Search feature on MDN and open the docs page
Compose email to recipient with subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>'
Type body with browser version and MDN docs URL
